column1: # The latest independent audit of each table: an auditor who did not write the entries drew a random sample of rows graded understood
# and re-derived each from the binaries or the cited specification. real = the entry held up, shallow = true but derived from a name or
# credited without behaviour of its own, wrong = contradicted. sample is small: read it with the percentage. The last row of a table with
# the latest date is the one summary.tsv and docs/coverage.md show.

column7: sample of 6 klconfig, hardware graph, NIC and serial-number routine entries (seed 20261102 over the entries of those pages): is_master_baseio, klhwg_mem_invent_info, nic_vmc_check, nic_bridge_vertex_info, board_serial_number_get and hubdev_unregister re-derived from the instruction listings, symbol tables and strings of the 6.5.30 kernels; all held

sample of 6 handler entries (same seed): profil, nice, getitimer, unlink, utssys and setregid re-derived from the 6.5.30 IP35 listings; all held; the getitimer entry listed two arguments of its helper call in the wrong order, reworded
sample of 4 syssgi entries (same seed): query_cyclecntr_size, query_fasttimer, sgi_symtab and numa_tests re-derived from the routine and case-code listings; all held

sample of 3 field tables (same seed): pciio_businfo_s, hubstat_s and pciio_win_info_s compared member by member with a separate dwarfdump read of the 6.5.30 IP27 kernel; hubstat_s also with IP35; all held

sample of 6 written conditions (same seed): the cmn_err sites in klhwg_add_all_routers, hub_dmamap_list, xtalk_error_handler, hub_device_inquiry, huberror_process_rrb_error and ecc_panic re-derived from the listings and message strings; the rrb condition named one branch of a three-way compare, rewritten to say what the earlier branches excluded

sample of the 20 checkable statements in the open-questions triage (e3109bc; seed 20261102 over the 25 numbered statements): kernel hashes, 6.5.22m string counts, absent 6.5.22 inventory and hash rows, scope.json names, sysmp and syssgi named-only rows on all five platforms, the 6.5.30 var and 6.5.22 var contents, the 230 IP32 entries, the 5 mconfig addresses against the symbol ranges and the mload_init end, the 361 and 529 panic counts, and the PE-brick, 0x8 and pending-clear readings re-derived with facts.py; the one shallow statement attributed the clear through the first interface to intr_clear_all when its helper does it, reworded

sample of 9 rows (seed 20261102 over the changed rows): the class table entries for tape, scsi, vscsi, prom, the helper class 25 and usb re-read from the hinv command (table address, name pointers, empty names for 25 and 27, class = index + 1), and the memory 6, memory 9 and MGRAS rows against every add-site in the three kernels; the constants, addresses and header names held. The one shallow row put the MGRAS add inside gfx_earlyinit although it is in an unnamed routine 0x5c bytes past that symbol, reworded. Outside the sample the site tracer ignored the instruction in a call's delay slot: a processor-class row (type 1/8) was a false hit, the instruction-cache row had no sites, and eleven add sites were listed unresolved; all fixed and regenerated

sample of 9 statements and rows from the driver, tunable and sysgen-page changes (seed 20261102): the 613 tunable lines and their static/run/none split recounted from the mtune files, the 450 master files with 444 header lines and 6 without, the 221 x-flag entries, the shared external majors 18 and 57 and their flags and per-machine USE lines, the 37 configured modules with no symbol under their prefix and the 28 symbol-bearing modules not configured recounted against the 6.5.22 IP27 symbol table, the refusal of a release without per-machine directories, and the bsd role against its master file and symbols; the shallow row was the if_eg role, derived from its name only, now backed by the kernel message strings and the master tables. Also corrected: a stub list for bsd that omitted its empty bsd_init, and a description of two header-less masters as retired when only one says so

sample of 2 changed items (seed 20261102): the IP30 pcibr_ioctl entry (address, size, frame, five request values, capability bit, copy size, callees and return values) and the scsi host adapter compare rule (the IP27 scsiha_ioctl paths for requests 29446 and 29473, the size-11 split, the credential capability test, the copy and ABI step) re-read from the instructions; both held. The rule could not be generated as committed: scsiha_ioctl was outside the in-scope names, so the inventory refused to write; fixed and the seven ioctl rows regenerated

sample of 4 of the 6.5.22 rows added for routines byte-identical to 6.5.30 (seed 20261102 over the 112 changed rows and routine reads; the five-routine read page was not drawn): xbow_bytes_to_gbr on 6.5.22 IP30 (bytes, SHA-256 prefix across five builds, the divide-by-4,000,000 rounding logic), hub_slot_to_crossbow, nic_read_one_page and nic_mfg_next re-derived from listings and relocations; all held; the three linked-kernel xbow_bytes_to_gbr rows said the body had a call, address constant or gp access and so were graded inferred, but it has none (its one constant is the number 4,000,000), so they are now established

sample of 8 entries of the debug-signature page (seed 20261102 over 1445 entries): klistio64 and ip_mrouter_set in the 6.5.30 IP27 kernel, idbg_pchain and idbg_link (IP35 idbg.o), re_comp and idbg_setpri (IP27 idbg.o), idbg_dobitmap and semctl_defkhlen (IP32 idbg.o) re-derived from dwarfdump of the same binaries (record offset, unit number, address range, return type, parameters, external flag) and the symbol table sizes; plus the idbg_findfunc fix (pointer to a pointer to a subroutine type) confirmed on IP27 and IP35 and the 40/40/62 return-type counts; all held

sample of 8 changed condition rows (seed 20261102 over the 27 rows written in the pcibr, ecc, sn0, hub, ioc3, nic and stray-report commits): sn0_error_dump probe_routers and tag 2903 on IP27, ecc_handler tag 2966, pcibr_debug allocation branch, nic_read_mfg crc16 report and nic_eaddr no-presence report on IP27, kl_panic and ecc_log on IP35 re-derived from the listings, gp-relative strings and branch targets; 7 held; the ecc_handler tag 2966 row called the 72(sp) word the one vararg though a3, a4 and a5 are all passed (shallow, reworded); a further read outside the draw found the IP27 hub_ioerror_handler condition omitted the branch that must be taken to reach the block and left the message unresolved, now corrected
